changes: Added detail to notes: 'yajamāna' is a generic ritual term, not a named person; the text after the colophon is ritual instruction and svasti verses.

notes: The catalogue lists Jaya Bhūpatīndra Malla (Bhaktapur, reigned c. 1696–1722) as king, but his name is not in the quoted colophon. He may be named somewhere else in the manuscript, so he is not recorded here. The colophon has no date and no named persons. 'yajamāna' in the Newari instruction (pithipūjā dhunakā va ... yajamāna lāsāva svastikasa ...) is a generic ritual role, not a named person. The text after the colophon is ritual instruction followed by svasti verses ('vidyācake (!)' probably stands for 'vidyācakre').
